title: SVM Approach-Based Direct Torque Control of a DFIG Used in a Wind Turbine
content: This article proposes a Direct Torque Control strategy based on Space Vector Modulation (DTCSVM). This approach offers advantages over conventional methods by improving system performance while significantly reducing electromagnetic torque and stator flux ripples. To further assess the impact of conventional Direct Torque Control (C-DTC) and DTC-SVM on power quality, a Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) analysis of the stator currents was conducted. The performance of both control strategies was evaluated under variations in stator flux and electromagnetic torque. The results demonstrate that the proposed DTC-SVM technique offers several advantages, including a fast dynamic response, a relatively simple implementation algorithm, and a constant switching frequency. Overall, the simulation results reveal improved control performance and confirm the effectiveness of the proposed strategy. The DTC-SVM scheme was validated through simulations conducted using MATLAB/Simulink.
